Seeds can be obtained by trading 3 [[Stardew:Gold Bar|Gold Bars]] for 1 golden carrot seed at the [[Stardew:Desert Trader|Desert Trader]], with the limited stock of 2 each day, via eliminating [[Monsters|Legendary Monsters]], or a rare drop from [[Stardew:Artifact Spots|Artifact Spots]]. Gold Carrot cannot be placed in the [[Stardew:Seed maker|Seed Maker]]. Mature plants yield a single Gold Carrot per harvest. ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Gold Carrot}} {{clear}}
